title: Hackers and Slashers
description:
Hackers and Slashers is a mod that overhauls minecraft's combat into something more akin to rpgs such as skyrim. This quest will go over the main mechanics.
Movesets: Each weapon is part of a category, and each category has its own animations and moveset.
Energy: There's a new bar above hunger representing energy. Certain actions like rolling, dashing, and blocking use it up, and it recovers over time.
Dashing and Rolling: You can dash (default key: x) and roll (default key: alt) both on ground and mid-air. Dashes move you in the direction you're moving and cost one energy point. Rolls cannot be used when holding a two handed weapon or with a shield in the off-hand, and they give brief invincibility frames, but cost 2 energy points.
Parrying: Blocking with a weapon right before an attack will perform a parry, stunning the mob briefly. You can also continue blocking with your weapon, but doing so consumes energy with eacha attack. Projectiles can be reflected the same way.
Critical Hits: Unlike vanilla combat, critical hits in Hackers and Slashers are performed in three ways. The first is attacking a stunned mob directly after parrying an attack. The second is sneaking up to them and attacking while undetected. The third is shooting the mob's head.
Kicking off: Holding the space key while against a mob will make you grab onto them. Letting go will then have you kick off them. This can stun mobs, as well as reset the drawing of a bow or crossbow.
